name: ui-click
prompt: A soft fingertip tap on a polished wooden button, short warm tick with a gentle room ambience.

name: ui-back
prompt: A muted wooden toggle flicking back, soft low knock with a brief felt brush.

name: pause
prompt: A heavy velvet curtain drawn halfway closed, soft fabric hush ending in a low gentle thump.

name: card-select
prompt: A single playing card lifted from a felt card table, crisp paper snap with a light finger slide.

name: card-play
prompt: A playing card placed firmly face-up onto a felt card table, sharp paper slap with a soft fabric thud.

name: card-pass
prompt: Three playing cards slid across green felt in one smooth motion, sustained soft paper whisper.

name: cards-deal
prompt: Playing cards dealt quickly one by one onto a wooden table, a rapid series of light paper snaps.

name: invalid
prompt: A knuckle rapping twice on a wooden table edge, dull short warning knocks.

name: turn-prompt
prompt: A small brass bell chimed once softly, gentle high ring with a quick natural decay.

name: hint
prompt: A fingernail tapping once on a glass conservatory pane, bright delicate ting.

name: undo
prompt: A playing card drawn back across felt toward the player's hand, soft dragging paper slide.

name: trick-take
prompt: A small stack of playing cards gathered and scooped across felt into a neat pile, layered paper slides ending with a soft tap.

name: heart-taken
prompt: A single card dropped onto a pile with a soft heavy landing, muted paper thud with low warmth.

name: queen-taken
prompt: A heavy card placed slowly and deliberately onto a wooden table, deep paper thud with a low room resonance.

name: eclipse
prompt: A full deck of cards fanned and swept in a wide arc across a table, dramatic cascading paper flourish.

name: round-end
prompt: A neat stack of cards squared up and tapped twice on the table, tidy paper taps with a settling shuffle.

name: match-win
prompt: A celebratory cascade of cards riffled and sprung between two hands, bright fluttering paper crescendo.

name: match-lose
prompt: Cards slowly gathered and stacked in near silence, slow deliberate paper slides ending in a single soft thud.
